title: Target-local entrance evidence graph
summary: Bind each entrance proposal to the requested public POI using proposal-context appearance instead of combining a global scene identity bit with a generic door bit.

mechanisms.name: Candidate-conditioned POI to entrance edge
mechanisms.description: Expand each door, gate, stairs, escalator, or passage proposal; compare its context against the public target roster; combine entrance support with normalized target margin; emit COMMIT, SET_VALUED, or SEARCH.
inputs: Entrance proposals, proposal-context CLIP and DINO vectors, public target reference bank, user goal
outputs: Unique target-bound entrance, bounded same-target entrance set, or fail-closed search
mechanisms.limitations: On 20 fresh public images the reducer removed 75 percent of generic false commits but made no correct unique entrance commit. Human pixel boxes exist only as Development current-view aperture truth; public access, traversability, localization, navigation, arrival, product, user-benefit, and safety remain unproved.
